title: The Homeostatic Vector Space of Microbes
description: Reproducible analysis code, processed tables, and figure-generation workflows for the microbial HRSM program. The repository assembles five retained transcriptomic branches: GSE36599 as a staged stress-recovery benchmark, GSE4370 as a continuous E. coli recovery backbone, GSE206609 as an explicit drug-recovery branch, GSE95575 as a conditioning-memory branch, and GSE188790 as an aged-versus-unaged E. coli branch.
